## Implementation Plan (Autonomous)

**Architecture:** PID extraction + platform-specific tree kill. Extract child PID before moving process into spawn_blocking, kill by PID from async side.

### Sub-Tasks

| # | Description | Files | Complexity | Deps |
|---|-------------|-------|------------|------|
| 1 | Add `pid()` method to PtyProcess trait | pty/mod.rs | Light | - |
| 2 | Create `process_kill` module (graceful→force tree kill) | process_kill.rs, lib.rs | Standard | - |
| 3 | Set process group flags at spawn (setsid/CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP) | pty/mod.rs | Light | - |
| 4 | Wire kill mechanism into executor (PID extraction + kill on signal/timeout) | executor.rs | Standard | 1,2,3 |
| 5 | Adjust daemon shutdown/concurrent kill timeouts | daemon/mod.rs | Light | 4 |
| 6 | Add kill termination tests | process_kill.rs, executor.rs | Standard | All |
| 7 | Update MockPtyProcess kill behavior | pty/mod.rs | Light | - |

### Dependency Graph
```
ST1, ST2, ST3, ST7 (parallel) → ST4 → ST5 → ST6
```

Plan reviewed and auto-approved (autonomous mode).
